line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decision: R2651 retains native readiness in the same short-circuit order and restores the original event-count line verbatim. park_native_owner(receiver) selects CSOwningThread, which can differ from receiver; replacing explicit task with PtiCurrent() breaks that call. Cleanup and send accounting use the supplied process domain; a global alias would lose that ownership. Native task binding provides projected structures and event primitives.

verification.scope: Rebuilt x86 product taskman.obj using its cached Ninja target; byte comparison with previous object excluding the COFF timestamp is identical.
